text:
jenna (new-hire): hey team, i'm booked for travel this friday and realized i'm shadowing the weekend oncall. worried about coverage — can someone confirm primary/secondary and any runbook pages i should skim before i go? :sweat_smile:
oncall-bot: weekly-shift-reminder - Jenna is scheduled as shadow for 2026-06-20 to 2026-06-21. Please confirm your buddy pairing. :calendar:
alice (infra): hey jenna :wave: — ok quick update: priya will be primary for the weekend, ben is secondary. marco and i are on standby for infra escalations. i'll add a short handover note here now.
alice (infra): Handover checklist (tick when done):
• confirm primary/secondary (done)
• share runbook links (below)
• provide a short list of likely pages and mitigations
• confirm escalation path to SRE lead

alice (infra): runbooks to skim: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/latency|Latency / High 95th pctp> , <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/storage-degraded|Storage degraded>. Key quick commands:```
# check autoscaler & pods
kubectl get hpa -n redwood-prod
kubectl get pods -l app=inference -n redwood-prod
# tail recent gateway errors
kubectl logs deploy/gateway -n redwood-prod --since=10m | grep 503
```

ben (sre): adding detail — if you get a page for 5xxs, first quick triage: 1) check gateway error rates, 2) check model-worker CPU / OOMs, 3) confirm if autoscaler is blocked. If traffic spike and HPA not scaling, toggle annotation:```
kubectl annotate deployment/gpu-workers cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict="true" -n redwood-prod
```
Then notify me and priya.

priya (eng-oncall): thanks! jenna — for shadowing, focus on the escalation snippet in the latency runbook. Also, practice a handoff message template. Quick example for end-of-shift handoff:```
Handoff: primary -> priya, secondary -> ben
Current state: incidents resolved / none / ongoing (link)
Open alerts: list with links
Pending mitigations: steps done & next steps
Estimated risk: low/medium/high
```

jenna (new-hire): got it — will read both runbooks and practice the handoff template. one more q: in case primary loses connectivity mid-shift, do we have a documented forced takeover step?

marco (platform): yes — forced takeover is just a handoff message in this channel + change in PagerDuty if needed. steps: 1) post takeover message, 2) update PagerDuty (assign new responder), 3) @sre-lead if incident escalated. I put the exact PD steps in the onboarding doc: <https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/pagerduty-takeover|PagerDuty takeover doc>.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT (P2) — spike in 503s for /v1/generate, 2500 req/min average, 5% error rate — recent deploy 15m ago. PagerDuty: pd_inc_98765.

ben (sre): i'm taking a quick look — priya, if this keeps climbing, switch traffic to the cheaper model variant (fallback) and open a rollback. I'll coordinate rollback if we need it. jenna — stay shadow-only for now, watch logs and follow runbook steps.

priya (eng-oncall): acknowledged. i see a canary host group showing high latency. running the healthcheck now.

jenna (new-hire): ok watching logs — seeing lots of this: `org.gw.RequestHandler - upstream returned 502`

ben (sre): that matches gateway failing to talk to inference pool. next step: check model-worker pods:```
kubectl describe pod $(kubectl get pods -l role=model-worker -n redwood-prod -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -n redwood-prod
```
If OOM/killed, we follow the storage-degraded path. If it's connectivity, try rolling restart of gateway group:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n redwood-prod
```

priya (eng-oncall): did the rollout restart — traffic dropping back to 1% errors. keeping watch for 5 minutes.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — error rate now 1.2% over 5m window. assigned: priya (primary), ben (secondary). :white_check_mark:

alice (infra): great mitigation. jenna — two learning notes for your shadow: 1) when there's a recent deploy, always check deploy tags + changelog before diving into infra, 2) keep concise handover notes (one-liner + links).

jenna (new-hire): thanks — will add a short note and mark this shadow as complete. quick question: should i still fill out the after-action checklist when i'm only shadowing?

ben (sre): yes please — even as shadow, capture timestamps and what you observed. add a short bullet in #oncall-incidents with your notes. that helps triage and blameless postmortem if needed.

priya (eng-oncall): agreed — also ping me if you want a short 15m debrief tomorrow. i'll walk through what we did.

jenna (new-hire): awesome — thanks everyone. leaving a short handoff now: Handoff -> priya primary; ben secondary; incident resolved; action item for jenna: read runbooks + submit shadow notes. :memo:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident pd_inc_98765 has been acknowledged by priya.

alice (infra): handoff confirmed. enjoy your trip jenna :airplane: — and welcome to oncall shadows, you did well in the live event.

jenna (new-hire): thanks!! :heart:
